description: Use this when the user requests verified daily technical analysis of one confirmed stock: SMA 20/50/200, RSI 14, trend states, momentum, price performance, ATR, relative volume, and historical volatility. Requires ValuEdge OAuth and uses one unit from the existing account research/valuation allowance; the same ledger and plan limits apply to web and MCP. This is an end-of-day snapshot, not an intraday price feed. Do not claim MACD, chart patterns, support or resistance levels unless independently available. Never fill null indicators or issue buy/sell instructions.
name: get_stock_technicals
title: Get stock technical analysis
